meta.description:
The official home of CBeebies on YouTube. Get ready to learn, laugh and play! Safe, fun and educational videos for toddlers and kids, from the BBC. Join the Squirrels and earn your badges with Hey Duggee, rock out with Andy and the Band and play games with Bluey, hooray!

https://www.bbc.co.uk/tv/cbeebies
